scoredItems.title: Recurrent patterns of TOP1-mediated neuronal genomic damage shared by major neurodegenerative disorders

scoredItems.explanation: Discovers a unifying mechanism of neuronal genomic instability in neurodegeneration, vital for therapeutic targets.
